visualCharacteristics.structure: image row + CTA bar (primary pill + secondary chevron link)

contentPattern: Row 1: banner image (alt empty or game name). Row 2: CTA paragraph(s): a bold link '**[Play now](...)**' as the primary pill button and a plain link '[TRY DEMO](...)' as a secondary chevron text link. Live-casino pages use a single bold '**[Browse Games](...)**' link. Breadcrumbs are not authored; scripts.js overlays them when page metadata 'Breadcrumbs: true'.
reuseGuidance: Use for game detail pages (casino, instant-win, live-casino) with a banner image and play/demo CTAs. Use the plain hero for banners with a heading.
